storage.name: Account
storage.docs: The full account information for a particular account ID.

constants.name: BlockHashCount
constants.docs: Maximum number of block number to block hash mappings to keep (oldest pruned first).

calls.name: transfer_keep_alive
calls.docs:
Same as the transfer call, but with a check that the transfer will not kill the
origin account.

errors.name: InsufficientBalance
errors.docs: Balance too low to send value.

constants.name: ExistentialDeposit
constants.docs: The minimum amount required to keep an account open.

calls.name: claim_name
calls.docs:
Claim a free name for the caller.
The deposit is reserved until the name is released.

calls.name: set_field
calls.docs: Set a public field of the caller's identity.

calls.name: request_attestation
calls.docs: Ask an authority to attest a field or record a fact.

errors.name: NameTaken
errors.docs: The name is held by another account.
